scope: A separately owner-adopted hypothetical fixture may satisfy DR217-B01 for STATIC_AUTHORED_PROCEDURE_REVIEW_ONLY, subject to successful witness review.

minimumBranchLocalPremises.required: One uniquely identified TEST_ONLY living creature; body, normal current/max HP, lifecycle, defenses, conditions, position, plane, equipment and custody. Select positive normal HP below 50; do not substitute an already-dead body.

Available soul; explicit eligibility under each retained capture predicate; permission and every binding, claim, custody or capture restriction. These are adopted hypothetical facts, not discoveries about a named campaign creature.

Exact initial Hunt state, provenance and no-farming history, including whether the victim is summoned, manufactured, previously captured, restored or recycled. Adoption cannot waive a bar or Hunt trigger.

Fully specified conditional caster with source-supported class/rank/level route, lawful acquisition/preparation, resources, components, hands, perception, range and line of effect. No new access route or free capability.

Exact commitment, resource/class bookkeeping, concentration consequences where applicable, response window and responder outcomes, resolution and pending-cast clearing. Preserve costs on interruption under retained rules.
Final Word itself must cause the qualifying final death in the fixture. HP zero, dying, another source's kill or a pre-existing corpse does not satisfy causation.

Exactly one source-defined reserve with stable victim/soul/death/cast provenance, followed by one lawful subsequent spell payment and its consumed/remainder disposition. No duplicate capture, refund, invented physical token or reusable reserve.
Body/corpse and equipment settlement, reserve ownership, and all applicable timing, expiry, suppression, ending and cleanup rules. Preserve irreversible expenditure and capture history.

requiredPreservation: Bind the fixture to the retained Final Word procedure and relevant lifecycle/Hunt rules. Preserve all 16 historical cases; construct only the new focused positive branch and source-required consequences. Include ordered states, ledgers and reversible verification; inverse replay is not in-game resurrection or refund.
nextDeliverable: A complete hash-bound fixture proposal with concrete values for the premises above. Request484 authorizes this route only; it is not itself a complete encounter specification.

ownerAdoption.template: I adopt Final Word TEST_ONLY fixture proposal SHA-256 <exact completed proposal hash> under DR217-B01-TESTONLY-ROUTE-484-01, solely for constructing and submitting its bounded static authored-procedure witness. I adopt its explicit hypothetical victim, eligibility, provenance, permissions, caster, resources, geometry and event inputs. Existing Final Word, lifecycle, capture, Hunt and payment rules remain controlling. This supplies no campaign facts or actual-source qualification and authorizes no seal, blocker closure, identity acceptance/application, canon or queue change.

bindingClarification.relation: Exact LF-to-CRLF conversion reproduces the declared working-tree hash. Request484's ancillary binding names the CRLF representation; downstream source bindings use the committed LF representation. This does not block the route ruling.
